entities.summary: Takashi Takeuchi (b. 1973-08-28, Chiba Prefecture) was a author or novelist of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Chiba Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of authors & novelists.
